subject: Draft MAP: Security evidence & SOC 2 delivery schedule
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecorp.com>, Tom Wu <tom.wu@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Draft MAP: Security evidence & SOC 2 delivery schedule

Hi Lina / Tom —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call and an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) draft attached. High-level ask: we want to align on the security review milestone items and target dates so your security team can validate whether the proposed cadence works for Acme.

Proposed high-level milestones (we put dates in the attached MAP_v0.3.pdf):
- Security questionnaire + answers (Redwood provides initial answers) — target: 2027-02-22
- SOC 2 artifacts & evidence packet (initial drop) — target: 2027-03-01
- Security review & clarifying follow-ups (Acme) — target: 2027-03-08
- Final technical onboarding and go/no-go — target: 2027-03-15 (target close date)

Owners we suggest:
- Redwood lead: Vanessa Ortiz (overall MAP coordination)
- Evidence pack owner: Marissa Cole (solutions engineering) — will collect SOC 2 report, pen test, controls matrix, logs samples
- Audit/logs point: Priyom Das (infosec) — will prepare redacted log samples and retention details
- Commercial/terms: Rishi Malhotra (sales) — will coordinate DPA and any procurement items

Dependencies noted in the MAP: legal sign-off on DPA and a short list of PV (privacy) questions from Acme to confirm what we can redact for shared artifacts. Please confirm: do you need the full SOC 2 Type II report or would a SOC 2 summary + controls matrix be OK for your initial review?

Attachments: MAP_v0.3.pdf (draft MAP), short attachment: map snapshot included in body.

Next step: Lina, if you can confirm the list of artifacts Acme requires and whether the proposed dates are feasible, we will lock the MAP and start assembling the evidence manifest. If you prefer, Marissa can host a 30-min walkthrough of artifacts later this week.

Thanks —
Vanessa Ortiz
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0191
From: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecorp.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tom Wu <tom.wu@acmecorp.com>
Date: Tue, 16 Feb 2027 09:07:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security evidence & SOC 2 delivery schedule

Hi Vanessa —

Appreciate the clear recap and the draft MAP. Quick answers from Acme security:

Required artifacts for initial review (minimum):
- SOC 2 Type II report (if available) or SOC 2 Type II + controls matrix summary
- Penetration test summary (last 12 months)
- High-level network/dataflow diagram (sensitive data flows highlighted)
- Data retention policy and S3/encryption-at-rest details
- List of subprocessors / hosting regions
- Sample audit logs (redacted) showing retention and access events

We can accept a redacted SOC 2 if you need to omit customer-specific NSAs, but we will need the controls mapping to your product features (auth, encryption, backup, incident response).

Timeline: the dates in your MAP are reasonable, but our security review team wants the SOC 2 / controls matrix by 2027-03-01 and the questionnaire answers by 2027-02-24 to have time for internal triage. If you can hit those windows, we should be OK to keep the 2027-03-15 go/no-go date.

I've attached our Acme_Security_Checklist.xlsx with the one-page artifact inventory and a few clarifying questions in column D. Marissa — can Redwood indicate whether the SOC 2 will be the full report or a summary + controls mapping?

Thanks —
Lina Park
Security Engineering Manager, Acme Corp
lina.park@acmecorp.com
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Lina Park <lina.park@acmecorp.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 11:34:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Draft MAP: Security evidence & SOC 2 delivery schedule

Hi Lina and team —

Thanks for the checklist, Lina. Quick confirmation from Redwood on deliverables and internal owners. We'll aim for the accelerated windows you requested. Below is what we'll deliver and owners/due dates: 

Planned artifact drop (initial):
- SOC 2 Type II (redacted where needed) + controls matrix mapping — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2027-03-01
- Pen test executive summary (last 12 months) — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2027-03-01
- Dataflow diagram (high-level) + list of environments/regions — Owner: Marissa Cole — Due: 2027-02-24
- Retention policy and encryption (at rest/in transit) statement — Owner: Priyom Das — Due: 2027-02-24
- Sample audit logs (redacted) & logging retention details — Owner: Priyom Das — Due: 2027-02-24
- Subprocessors & hosting region list — Owner: Rishi Malhotra — Due: 2027-02-22

Interim milestone: questionnaire answers (we will provide initial answers to the checklist) — Owner: Vanessa/Marissa — Due: 2027-02-22

Dependencies / blockers we flagged:
- Legal DPA sign-off (Rishi to coordinate with Acme procurement) — this may be required before some artifacts are shared without additional NDA redactions
- If you require raw logs (non-redacted), we will need a controlled evidence transfer plan and a short MoU — please advise if that is the case

I'll start assembling an evidence_manifest.txt (index of files and brief descriptions) and circulate once the first bundle is ready.

Attachments: evidence_manifest.txt (placeholder list will be expanded).

Marissa Cole
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

Thanks all — appreciate the alignment.

Action summary and next steps (short):
- Rishi: coordinate DPA and confirm procurement timeline with Tom (due 2027-02-20)
- Marissa: upload initial evidence bundle to the secure Drive folder and ping Lina when ready (target 2027-03-01)
- Priyom: prepare redacted logs + retention statement (target 2027-02-24)
- Vanessa: finalize MAP doc and post the agreed milestones to HubSpot (I updated the deal record)

Links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/deals/ACME-2027-001), MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-MAP-Acme)

If anything shifts on your side, Lina, please flag — otherwise we'll proceed to the dates above. Looking forward to the walkthrough if you want one.

Cheers —
Vanessa
